rules.first: per cell the frozen-order prefix whose expected yield reaches the target
rules.top_up: ceil(remaining units / observed units per attempted task x top_up_margin); with nothing admitted yet, the pessimistic prefix of what is left; the LAST round (max_rounds) takes every task left within the bound
rules.bound: a cell never attempts more than the frozen-order prefix whose pessimistic yield (the lower end of its measured stratum, else the low tokens per turn and pass rate) reaches its target, nor more than its supply; a whole-supply cell (six_category_common_support.json :: whole_supply_cells) is bound by its whole remaining supply; a cell still short at its bound or after max_rounds is a SHORTFALL -- of its bound when supply remains (a top-up continues from the frozen order), of its source only when its whole supply was attempted
rules.invocations: one engine invocation per mode and round for the first candidates, one for the second candidates of the round's refused tasks
rules._first_round_bound_lineages: a lineage whose remaining cumulative budget holds about ONE round takes its cells' bound in round 1 instead of the expected prefix (maintainer 2026-11-05, review of f06ccd4, section 3: Thinking-2507's top-up inside the real remainder of its $2.78, $1.5371 = about 22 driver minutes at $1.09/h; one round with its tail, rarely two). The bound is the prefix whose measured LOWER yield reaches the target, which the upper price already pays for; every task is a new one in the frozen order, and admitted episodes beyond a target stay unused (six_category_common_support.json :: freeze); for such a lineage a cell's bound is also at least the shortest prefix whose admitted episodes reach the remaining target with probability >= 0.95 at its measured stratum's lower Wilson admission yield (tool_generation_plan.reach_bound): a small gap's mean-yield prefix is a coin flip, and one round must reach it (maintainer 2026-11-05: the top-up continues until the quota is reached, the supply is exhausted or the budget boundary is hit); the hybrid joined on 2026-11-05 after its first formal session (a_tool_generation_20261105_074146, $3.1438 of its cumulative $9.13): its remainder holds about one more session, and a split's own stratum decides a reach bound once it holds >= 5 attempted tasks (tool_generation_plan.reach_stratum)

price.basis: the pilot's measured generated tokens per attempted task (every candidate, its measured second-candidate rate), measured output tokens per second and engine starts, measured session overhead; the cap is the runner's own all-in at $1.19/h for the upper level's driver minutes; strata the pilot did not measure are priced by proxy or prior and listed in generated_tokens_by_basis
